biotools.summary: MRMQuant is an automated tool for targeted metabolomic quantitation using high-throughput liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry MRM data. It provides users with an easy-to-use interface for accurate MRM data quantitation, minimizing human intervention and offering features like dynamic signal smoothing and batch-effect correction.
